title: 💈IRISH CLIPS💈  This is basically a higher version of the bib clip, an...
description: 💈IRISH CLIPS💈  This is basically a higher version of the bib clip, and great for horses in light to medium work.  It’s a very quick and easy clip to do, so it’s ideal for a first clip or youngster.  Hair from the neck, shoulders and belly is clipped. The line can be adjusted higher or lower to suit your needs. You can also choose how far back to clip - you may choose this clip if your horse is particularly sensitive around the stifle area and gets ‘kicky’ as you can avoid this area if needed.  Most often a half face is chosen when doing this clip. Depending on the height of the line (which may meet the top line or back of the ears) you could leave the face, or fully clip it.  Using my @liveryman_ Black Beauty Clippers  #equestrian #equestrianvibes #oddlysatisfying #horse #fypequestrian #horseclipping
